# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated from src/config/env.ts by `npm run env:docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every environment variable Maxx reads, generated from the one schema in
[`src/config/env.ts`](../src/config/env.ts). The server validates it at startup and logs each
problem by variable name, never by value; `npm run doctor` and the in-app setup checklist
(`/setup`) run the same checks. `npm run setup` writes `.env.local` (mode 600) for you.

106 variables, 22 secret, 13 public.

- **Secret** values are never printed, logged, returned by an API or shown in the app.
- **Public** (`NEXT_PUBLIC_*`) values are inlined into the browser bundle at build time: change
  them, then rebuild. No secret is ever public (enforced by `tests/env-schema-population.test.ts`).
- Secrets stay in environment variables: Vercel cannot write them at runtime. Non-secret settings
  that the app stores (outcome sources on or off) are changed in the app.

## Database (Supabase)

The warehouse, sign-in and Row Level Security. Required.

| Variable | Required | Kind | Default | Format | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` | yes | public (browser) | - | an https URL (http://127.0.0.1 or http://localhost for a local stack) | Your Supabase project URL. The browser uses it for sign-in; the server for every database read. |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` | yes | public (browser) | - | a key of at least 20 characters | Supabase anon (publishable) key. Browser-safe: the shipped schema grants the anon role nothing, so a leaked anon key reads no data. |
| `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` | yes | secret | - | a key of at least 20 characters | Server-only key with full database access, used by API routes after the owner check and by cron and webhook handlers. It is the whole authorization boundary: keep it off machines that do not need it. |

## Owner

One owner per install. Only this account can sign in.

| Variable | Required | Kind | Default | Format | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `OWNER_EMAIL` | yes | - | - | an email address | The one Supabase Auth user allowed in. Unset denies everyone, in development too. Disable public sign-ups in Supabase as well (`npm run doctor` checks it). |
| `OWNER_USER_ID` | no | - | - | a uuid such as 0d6f…-… | Optional Supabase user id of the owner. When set, production also requires the signed-in user to have this id, so a second account holding the owner address is refused. `npm run setup` records it when it creates the owner. Recorded by `npm run setup`. |

## Scheduled jobs

The daily and midday syncs authenticate with this secret.

| Variable | Required | Kind | Default | Format | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CRON_SECRET` | in production | secret | - | at least 32 characters (setup generates 64 hex characters) | Bearer secret for /api/cron/* and /api/sync/midday, compared in constant time. Shorter than 32 characters is treated as unset (the endpoints answer 503). Vercel sends it automatically when it is set in the project. Generated by `npm run setup`. |

## Meta

Read access to one ad account. Live writes stay off unless you enable them.

| Variable | Required | Kind | Default | Format | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `META_ACCESS_TOKEN` | before the dashboard shows data | secret | - | a non-empty value | Meta System User token with ads_read (ads_management only if you enable live writes). Sent in the Authorization header, never in a URL. |
| `META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID` | before the dashboard shows data | - | - | act_ followed by digits, e.g. act_1234567890 | The one Meta ad account this install reads. |
| `META_APP_SECRET` | when META_APPSECRET_PROOF_ENABLED=true | secret | - | a non-empty value | Secret of the Meta app that minted the token. With META_APPSECRET_PROOF_ENABLED=true every Graph call carries appsecret_proof, so a stolen token is useless without it (turn on "Require App Secret" in the Meta app too). |
| `META_APPSECRET_PROOF_ENABLED` | no | - | `false` | true or false | Send appsecret_proof on every Graph call. Keep true. |
| `META_API_VERSION` | no | - | - | a Graph API version such as v25.0 | Emergency pin of the Graph API version without a deploy. Empty uses the version pinned in src/lib/platforms/meta/api-version.ts. |
| `META_AD_LIBRARY_COUNTRIES` | no | - | - | comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes, e.g. DE,AT | Countries the competitor Ad Library search covers (ad_reached_countries), as comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes. Unset uses the ad account's business country as Meta reports it, or US when Meta reports none. An invalid list stops the search rather than using another country. |
| `META_PIXEL_ID` | no | - | - | digits only | Pixel (dataset) id for Conversions API sends and tracking-health checks. |
| `META_CAPI_ACCESS_TOKEN` | no | secret | - | a non-empty value | Optional dataset-scoped Conversions API token from Events Manager; preferred over reusing META_ACCESS_TOKEN. |
| `META_TEST_EVENT_CODE` | no | - | - | a non-empty value | Events Manager test code; with a send mode of `test`, conversions go to the Test Events tab only. |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_META_OUTCOME_EVENT` | no | public (browser) | `AppointmentConfirmed` | an event name of letters, digits and underscores | Meta pixel event that marks an outcome (Results, actions and tracking health count it), for example Purchase or Lead. Public so the browser counts the same event as the server. |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_META_OUTCOME_CONVERSION_ID` | no | public (browser) | - | digits only | Numeric id of a Meta custom conversion that represents an outcome (counted in addition to the named outcome event). Public so the browser counts the same actions as the server. |
| `META_APPOINTMENT_CONVERSION_ID` | no | deprecated: use `NEXT_PUBLIC_META_OUTCOME_CONVERSION_ID` | - | digits only | Deprecated server-only name of NEXT_PUBLIC_META_OUTCOME_CONVERSION_ID, still accepted; the browser never sees it. |
| `WRITE_MODE_ENABLED` | no | - | `false` | true to enable; anything else is off | Exactly `true` enables the executor that can change the ad account. Each write still needs an owner approval in the app. Leave off unless you need it. |
| `MAX_BUDGET_CHANGE_PERCENT` | no | - | `50` | a positive whole number | Largest daily-budget step, in percent of the current budget, that one change you propose may make without an explicit override confirmation. The account-total ceiling (DAILY_BUDGET_CEILING) still applies above it. |
| `CHANGE_RECOVERY_STALE_MINUTES` | no | - | `15` | a positive whole number | Minutes after which a change whose run never finished counts as stuck, so you can recover it on Changes ("Recover stuck change"). Keep it above your longest run; on Vercel a run stops after 300 seconds. |

## Business profile

Facts about the business. Timezone and currency must equal the ad account's own.

| Variable | Required | Kind | Default | Format | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_BUSINESS_NAME` | no | public (browser) | - | a non-empty value | Name shown in the app chrome. |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_ACCOUNT_TIMEZONE` | no | public (browser) | `America/New_York` | an IANA timezone such as Europe/Berlin | IANA timezone of the ad account. Every business date, reporting window and contract uses it. It must equal the ad account's timezone_name: a mismatch is refused, never silently mixed. |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_ACCOUNT_CURRENCY` | no | public (browser) | `USD` | an upper-case ISO 4217 code such as EUR | ISO 4217 currency of the ad account. Must equal the ad account's currency. Totals across currencies are refused, never summed. |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_ACCOUNT_LOCALE` | no | public (browser) | `en-US` | a BCP 47 locale such as de-DE | BCP 47 locale for numbers, money and dates on owner screens (e.g. de-DE). Formatting only: it never changes the currency or the timezone. |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_OUTCOME_NOUN` | no | public (browser) | `outcome/outcomes` | singular/plural, such as booking/bookings or order/orders | What your business calls its outcomes on screen, as singular/plural (booking/bookings, order/orders, lead/leads). Wording only: it never changes what is counted. Meta-reported events keep Meta's own names. |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_BUSINESS_HOURLY_RATE` | no | public (browser) | `95` | a positive number | Your hourly rate in the account currency; only the competitor comparison panel reads it. |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_BUSINESS_HOURLY_RATE_USD` | no | public (browser), deprecated: use `NEXT_PUBLIC_BUSINESS_HOURLY_RATE` | - | a positive number | Deprecated name of NEXT_PUBLIC_BUSINESS_HOURLY_RATE, still accepted for one release. |
| `BUSINESS_PROFILE_JSON` | no | - | - | a JSON object on one line | Partial JSON override of src/config/business-profile.ts (description, website, booking page, city, differentiators, pricing, claims requiring verification). Validated at startup; invalid JSON fails loudly. |
| `DAILY_BUDGET_CEILING` | no | - | `100` | a positive number | Owner-approved account-total daily budget ceiling, in the account currency. Recommendations never exceed it. |
| `DAILY_BUDGET_CEILING_USD` | no | deprecated: use `DAILY_BUDGET_CEILING` | - | a positive number | Deprecated name of DAILY_BUDGET_CEILING, still accepted for one release. |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_MIN_SPEND_TO_JUDGE` | no | public (browser) | `20` | a positive decimal amount such as 3000 or 12.5 | Spend, in the account currency, below which an ad, ad set or campaign is too early to judge. Every other spend floor (dormancy, alerts, target-range minimum spend, trend and pattern thresholds) is a fixed multiple of it. The default suits currencies with USD-sized units; set a larger amount for currencies with small units, e.g. 3000 for JPY. |

## Outcome sources and conversions

Business results come from outcome sources (CSV, signed webhook, or the optional reference scheduling adapter). Enable or disable each one on the Outcome sources screen; these variables configure the reference adapter and conversions sending.

| Variable | Required | Kind | Default | Format | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ACUITY_USER_ID` | when ACUITY_API_KEY is set | - | - | digits only | Acuity Scheduling user id for the optional Acuity example adapter. Needs ACUITY_API_KEY. |
| `ACUITY_API_KEY` | when ACUITY_USER_ID is set | secret | - | a non-empty value | Acuity API key; also the HMAC key Acuity signs its webhooks with. |
| `ACUITY_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | no | secret | - | a non-empty value | Optional extra `?secret=` the Acuity webhook URL must carry. |
| `ACUITY_CAPI_SEND` | no | - | `off` | one of off, test, live | Conversions API sends for Acuity outcomes: off, test (Test Events only) or live. |
| `ACUITY_BACKFILL_START` | no | scripts only | - | a date YYYY-MM-DD | First date scripts/backfill-acuity.ts pulls. |
| `CONVERSIONS_PHONE_COUNTRY_CODE` | no | - | - | a country calling code of 1 to 3 digits without +, such as 44 | Country calling code added to customer phone numbers written without one (44 for the United Kingdom, 49 for Germany, 1 for the United States and Canada) before they are hashed for the Conversions API; a national trunk 0 is removed first. Unset adds no code, so national numbers cannot match. Numbers written with + or 00 keep their own code. |
| `OUTCOME_MONEY_CEILING` | no | - | `1000000000` | a positive number | Largest value of one outcome, in major units of the account currency, accepted from the outcome webhook or a CSV import. A larger value is refused with a 4xx and never sent to the Conversions API. |
| `OUTCOME_CONVERSIONS_SEND` | no | - | `off` | one of off, test, true | Conversions API sends for generic (webhook) outcomes: off, test or true. Separate from the reference adapter send flag; CSV outcomes are never sent. |

## Paid-touch capture

Exact ad-click to outcome linking (ADR-056). Inert unless all four values are set.

| Variable | Required | Kind | Default | Format | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PAID_TOUCH_TOKEN_SECRET` | when paid-touch capture is configured | secret | - | at least 32 bytes (setup generates 64 hex characters) | Signs paid-touch tokens. Setup generates it; the endpoint stays inert until the other three paid-touch values are set too. Generated by `npm run setup`. |
| `PAID_TOUCH_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | when paid-touch capture is configured | - | - | comma-separated exact https origins, e.g. https://www.example.com | Exact https origins of your website allowed to call /api/attribution/paid-touch (a browser guard, not authentication). |
| `PAID_TOUCH_ALLOWED_LANDING_HOSTS` | when paid-touch capture is configured | - | - | comma-separated host names, e.g. www.example.com | Landing-page hosts whose ad clicks are captured. |
| `ACUITY_PAID_TOUCH_FIELD_ID` | when paid-touch capture is configured | - | - | digits only | Id of the hidden Acuity intake field that carries the paid-touch token. |
| `PAID_TOUCH_GLOBAL_CAPTURES_PER_HOUR` | no | - | `2000` | a positive whole number | Site-wide ceiling on accepted paid-touch captures per hour, whatever client address a request claims. |
| `PAID_TOUCH_GLOBAL_ACKS_PER_HOUR` | no | - | `4000` | a positive whole number | Site-wide ceiling on accepted paid-touch delivery acknowledgements per hour. |
| `PAID_TOUCH_UNKNOWN_AD_CAPTURES_PER_HOUR` | no | - | `200` | a positive whole number | Site-wide ceiling per hour on captures naming an ad not yet synced (a new launch or a forged id); they are kept, not refused. |
| `PAID_TOUCH_RETENTION_DAYS` | no | - | `180` | a positive whole number | Days after which the daily sync deletes paid-touch rows that never became evidence (rejected captures, unlinked touches, expired unused tokens). At least 30. |
| `PAID_TOUCH_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS` | no | - | `1` | an integer from 0 to 5 | How many reverse proxies append to X-Forwarded-For in front of the app (Vercel: 1). The rate limit keys on the address that many hops from the end. |

## Google Analytics 4

Optional web telemetry.

| Variable | Required | Kind | Default | Format | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GA4_PROPERTY_ID` | when GA4_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON is set | - | - | digits only | GA4 property id for web telemetry. Optional; needs GA4_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON. |
| `GA4_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON` | when GA4_PROPERTY_ID is set | secret | - | the full Google service-account JSON on one line, with a private_key | The full service-account JSON key on one line; the account needs Viewer on the property. |
| `GA4_BOOKING_EVENT` | no | - | `appointment_confirmed` | a GA4 event name: a letter, then letters, digits or underscores, at most 40 characters | GA4 event name that marks an outcome on your website; the website report counts it as Confirmation events. |
| `GA4_INTENT_EVENTS` | no | - | `begin_checkout` | comma-separated GA4 event names (each a letter, then letters, digits or underscores, at most 40 characters) | GA4 events counted as Intent events on the website report (a visitor starting to buy or book), comma-separated. |
| `GA4_LEAD_EVENTS` | no | - | `generate_lead` | comma-separated GA4 event names (each a letter, then letters, digits or underscores, at most 40 characters) | GA4 events counted as Lead events on the website report (an enquiry or form submission), comma-separated. |

## AI

Optional. Every core page and report works with AI off. Provider rules are validated by src/lib/ai/config.ts.

| Variable | Required | Kind | Default | Format | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AI_PROVIDER` | no | - | - | one of anthropic, bedrock, vertex, foundry, openai-compatible, none | AI provider: anthropic, bedrock, vertex, foundry, openai-compatible or none. Unset means anthropic when a Claude key is present, else off. Every report works with AI off. |
| `AI_MODEL` | when AI_PROVIDER=openai-compatible | - | - | a model id with no spaces | Model id. Defaults to claude-opus-5-5 (Bedrock: anthropic.claude-opus-5-5); required for openai-compatible. |
| `AI_EFFORT` | no | - | `medium` | one of low, medium, high, xhigh, max, none | Effort for chat: low, medium, high, xhigh, max, or none for models without effort. Batch features use low. |
| `AI_FALLBACKS` | no | - | - | a non-empty value | Refusal fallback: default (Claude API server-side), off, or 1-3 comma-separated model ids. |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | when AI_PROVIDER=anthropic and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN is unset | secret | - | a non-empty value | Claude API key (AI_PROVIDER=anthropic, or unset). |
| `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` | no | secret | - | a non-empty value | Claude API bearer token, an alternative to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. |
| `AWS_REGION` | when AI_PROVIDER=bedrock and AWS_DEFAULT_REGION is unset | - | - | a non-empty value | AWS region for AI_PROVIDER=bedrock (or AWS_DEFAULT_REGION). |
| `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION` | no | - | - | a non-empty value | Fallback AWS region for Bedrock. |
| `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` | no | secret | - | a non-empty value | Bedrock credentials, read by the AWS SDK credential chain (or use a role or profile). |
| `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` | no | secret | - | a non-empty value | Bedrock credentials, read by the AWS SDK credential chain. |
| `AWS_SESSION_TOKEN` | no | secret | - | a non-empty value | Temporary Bedrock credentials, read by the AWS SDK credential chain. |
| `CLOUD_ML_REGION` | no | - | `global` | a non-empty value | Vertex AI region for AI_PROVIDER=vertex. |
| `ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID` | no | - | - | a non-empty value | Google Cloud project for Vertex AI. |
| `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS` | no | - | - | a non-empty value | Path to Google credentials for Vertex AI, read by the Google auth library. |
| `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_RESOURCE` | when AI_PROVIDER=foundry and ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_BASE_URL is unset | - | - | a non-empty value | Microsoft Foundry resource name (or ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_BASE_URL). |
| `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_BASE_URL` | no | - | - | an http or https URL | Microsoft Foundry endpoint URL. |
| `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_API_KEY` | when AI_PROVIDER=foundry | secret | - | a non-empty value | Microsoft Foundry API key. |
| `OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_BASE_URL` | when AI_PROVIDER=openai-compatible | - | - | an http or https URL | Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible server, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1. |
| `OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY` | no | secret | - | a non-empty value | API key for the OpenAI-compatible server, if it needs one. |
| `OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_MAX_TOKENS_FIELD` | no | - | `max_tokens` | one of max_tokens, max_completion_tokens | max_tokens or max_completion_tokens, whichever the server accepts. |
| `MAXX_CHAT_ENABLED` | no | - | `false` | true to enable; anything else is off | Exactly `true` turns on owner chat (it also needs a configured AI provider). |
| `CREATIFY_API_KEY` | no | secret | - | a non-empty value | Optional Creatify key for video generation; blocked while AI is off. |

## Set by the host

You do not set these; Next.js, Vercel, CI or a cloud SDK does. Listed because the code reads them.

| Variable | Required | Kind | Default | Format | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `APP_URL` | in production off Vercel | - | - | an http or https URL | The public URL the browser uses for Maxx, e.g. https://maxx.example.com. Sign-in redirects and the same-origin check on every change use it: behind `next start` (and most reverse proxies) the server only sees localhost. Required in production off Vercel; on Vercel the deployment hosts are used when it is unset. |
| `NODE_ENV` | no | - | - | one of development, production, test | Set by Next.js: production for `next build`/`next start` and on Vercel. Production makes the owner gate fail closed. |
| `NEXT_RUNTIME` | no | - | - | one of nodejs, edge | Set by Next.js: nodejs or edge. |
| `VERCEL` | no | - | - | any text | Set by Vercel to 1 on its build and runtime. Demo mode is refused when it is set. |
| `VERCEL_ENV` | no | - | - | one of production, preview, development | Set by Vercel: production, preview or development. |
| `VERCEL_URL` | no | - | - | a non-empty value | Set by Vercel: the deployment host. |
| `VERCEL_PROJECT_PRODUCTION_URL` | no | - | - | a non-empty value | Set by Vercel: the production host. |
| `VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA` | no | - | - | a non-empty value | Set by Vercel: the deployed commit. |
| `VERCEL_DEPLOYMENT_ID` | no | - | - | a non-empty value | Set by Vercel: the deployment id. |
| `CI` | no | - | - | any text | Set by CI systems. Setup and the install message are silent and non-interactive when it is set. |

## Operator tooling

Read only by scripts (setup, demo, evaluations). Do not add them to a deployment.

| Variable | Required | Kind | Default | Format | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SUPABASE_DB_URL` | no | secret, scripts only | - | a postgres:// or postgresql:// connection string | Postgres connection string that `npm run setup` passes to `supabase db push --db-url` to apply the schema. Read only by setup; never written to .env.local. |
| `MAXX_DEMO` | no | scripts only | - | one of 0, 1 | Set to 1 only by `npm run demo`: sample data, no accounts. Refused in production (the server will not start). |
| `MAXX_ENV_FILE` | no | scripts only | `.env.local` | a non-empty value | Env file that setup and doctor read and write (default .env.local). |
| `MAXX_EVAL_QUESTIONS_FILE` | no | scripts only | - | a non-empty value | Question file for `npm run eval:golden`. |

## Development and test variables

Read only by tests and tooling, never by the app: `SB_*` (local Supabase for integration tests),
`E2E_*` (Playwright against a running deployment), `MAXX_EVAL_*`, `PROMPTFOO_*`, `OTEL_*`,
`MAXX_TEST_*`, `MAXX_REPORTING_SCENARIO`, `MAXX_RECORDED_PACKETS`, `REPORTING_CREATIVE_UI_BROWSER`,
`DIGEST_PREVIEW`, `MAXX_EXPLAIN_WITHHOLD`.
